resources.string: This app provides no pinnable shortcuts.
Resets the colors of every widget, card, Dock, Panel and search part to the new mode. Your backgrounds and pictures stay as they are. Each surface can still be changed on its own afterwards.
Used by the app list\'s scroll bubble and the charging animation. The charging animation can also get its own color in its own settings.
Designs, color modes, accent, font, corners, background, icons, animations
Shape, size and icon pack for every app
Permissions, language, default apps, tips, backup
Tap a point on the widget to use that exact color.
Apps, folders, places, links, action buttons
No action buttons yet — create one in Settings -> Elements -> Action buttons.
Bubbles rise across the home screen while the device is charging.
Pinning and launching app shortcuts. Granted with the default launcher role.
Current playback in the music widget.
Set Freiraum as the default launcher.
Hide and rename apps, icons, icon pack
Appearance, border and visibility shared by every folder
Deletes the folder and all its contents permanently.
The same background used everywhere, set once in Global settings.
One background image or color for every screen
Also hides the app from app pickers. Placements on pages, in the dock and in folders remain.
Hides the app from text search results.
Findable only by typing the exact code below, instead of by name.
Long press, double tap, swipes, home button
Used by the Dock to open/close
Used by the Panel to open
Only these apps\' playback shows up in the music widget and is controlled by it. With none checked, every app counts, including browsers and video apps.
Gives the large album cover rounded corners instead of square ones.
Swiping past the last page continues with the first one, and back, round in a circle.
No rows on this page. Use “Add row” to add a widget or an element box.
Fullscreen list of all apps. Opened by a gesture (default: swipe up, see Gestures).
It doesn\'t fit here alongside what\'s already on this page. Add a new page for it?
Removes the side margin so the widget spans the full screen width. Off by default; the width then matches the dock.
Removes the side margin so it spans the full screen width. Off by default: a fine margin to the screen edge stays.
Empty: your language\'s usual format, e.g. “Monday, 10/26/2026”. Otherwise a date pattern, for example “EEEE, MM/dd/yyyy” or “MMM d”.
Shows the next alarm below the date. Requires no additional permission.
Entries in one non-wrapping row instead of a grid — used by the dock
No other folders. Create one above.

A backup holds everything to move Freiraum to a new phone or set it up again without starting over: your look (color modes, colors, borders, corners, effects, backgrounds, installed designs and wallpapers) and your own things (pages, apps, folders, notes, addresses, contacts, links). Importing replaces everything and restarts the launcher.
Replaces everything with the content of the file: look, designs, wallpapers, backgrounds, pages, apps, folders and personal data. Freiraum restarts afterwards.
Backup found. Restarting to apply it…
Backup was created with a newer Freiraum version
Turns the status bar off on every page, quick overview, text search and folders. You can turn it back on individually per screen afterwards. A swipe down from the top edge always shows it briefly.
This hides the status bar on every page, quick overview, text search and folders at once, overriding whatever each one is currently set to.
Off by default, so the floating dock stays visible while a folder is open.
Floating search button in the app list, positioned like the dock button.
A slim strip with rounded corners right above the keyboard. Match its color to your keyboard to give the keyboard rounded top corners. While it is on, it counts as the top edge of the keyboard.

Tip for an exact match: open the keyboard anywhere and take a screenshot. Read the keyboard color from the screenshot with any color picker app, then paste the hex code (e.g. #ECEEF4) into the hex field here.
Shows a small arrow in the strip. Tapping the strip closes the keyboard; swiping back still works as before.
Off: search opens with just the input field; tap it to show the keyboard.
No phone number for this contact.

Two switches per category. Search: its results come with every query. Rail: it has a place in the rail beside the results. Both = always there. Only Search = results without a place in the rail. Only Rail = on demand, its results show only after a tap on it in the rail. Neither = off. Tap a symbol to change it and its color, drag to change the order. Web and Maps only hand the query to your browser or maps app; the launcher itself never goes online.
By default the browser and maps app set in Android are used. Here you can pick a different one just for Freiraum. If it cannot open a request, the system default is used instead.
No weather data. Data is supplied by Breezy Weather or Gadgetbridge.
This widget is no longer available. Its app was removed or the widget was restored from a backup — remove it and add it again.

No internet permission, no data collection. Everything stays on your phone.
All apps as a grid with its own search field. Opened by a gesture, an action button or a dock slot.
Tapping the field opens the full Text search instead of filtering the grid.
The strip above the keyboard follows the Text search settings.
Choose which of your folders appear in the grid.
Hide apps that are in these folders
The search button opens a search for apps right in the list instead of Text search.
Can make swiping between pages less smooth
The launcher stays upright when the device is turned
Freiraum on tablets is still experimental: some screens may not look or work quite right yet. Feedback is welcome on GitHub.
Symbol, opacity, fill, border and corners
Even at 0 the buttons can still be tapped, they are just invisible.
Weather: the upright buttons move the hours, the wide ones the days. Notes: the buttons sit left of the plus.
A calm, tidy home screen. Pages, widgets, search and looks all adapt to you, and nothing leaves your phone.
This is how you get everywhere. Tap a gesture to choose what it opens. Later you can change it any time under Settings → Pages → Gestures.

The button with the sliders in the Dock opens the settings. If you remove it, you still find them in Text search under Freiraum settings, or in the app info for Freiraum in Android. Under Extensions you can add designs, wallpapers and widgets there later.
Everything here is optional, and Freiraum has no internet access. Tap a row to allow it now, or later in the settings.
Your wallpaper has a picture for the lock screen too. Use it there? Only the lock screen changes.

Apps, folders and pages zoom out of what you tapped, pages sink back a little while swiping, and the back swipe shrinks the screen with your finger. If Android\'s Remove animations is on, there are none.
That\'s why Freiraum shows no animations. Tap to open Android\'s accessibility settings (Color and motion).
Apps open out of their icon
App list, App grid and search zoom in
Ready-made looks with colors, borders, corners and effects

A design only changes the look: colors, borders, corners and effects. Your pages, apps, folders and notes stay as they are, and so do your backgrounds, which come with wallpapers. Freiraum has no internet access, so designs are downloaded in the browser and then added here.
Opens the designs in the overview in the browser
Brings back the colors, borders, corners and effects you had before you applied a design
To share it or as a start for your own design
That is not a valid Freiraum design
Also set the lock screen wallpaper
Looks great, but uses a little more battery
The design file is deleted from Freiraum. You can add it again any time.
This design is in use. Freiraum goes back to your own look first, then deletes the design.

The backup holds your whole launcher: the look with designs, wallpapers and backgrounds, and personal data like notes, places, contacts, links and your apps. Keep it for yourself and do not share it. To share only a look, save it as a design instead.
The higher, the rounder. Very round corners can cut into the content at the edge of the widget.
A design holds only the look: colors, borders, corners and effects. No personal data and no pictures, so you can share it safely.
A wallpaper brings a picture for each page: Home, App list, Text search, App grid, more for further pages, and one for the lock screen. Wallpapers go with every design.
Opens the wallpapers in the overview in the browser
Every page gets the plain background of the color mode: matte black in dark mode, chalk white in light mode. Your own pictures on the pages are replaced.
The pictures go onto Home, App list, Text search and App grid, the rest onto your further pages in their order. Pictures you set yourself are replaced.
This is not a Freiraum wallpaper
The wallpaper is deleted from Freiraum. The pictures stay on your pages until you choose others.
Takes everything recommended. You can change all of it later in the settings.
Colors, borders and effects. You see it right away on your home screen above. Neon and 3D are downloads.
A picture for every page, going with any design. More are downloads.
How round the corners are, for everything at once or each part on its own.
How this widget turns its pages (hours and days, notes). The look of the buttons is shared by all widgets.
Launcher: the home screen, its pages, widgets and folders. Settings and welcome tour: only these screens, so they can be light while the launcher is dark, or the other way round.
You can pick your own pictures any time later: Settings → Appearance → Background, or in the settings of each page.
Round, soft or square, for everything or part by part
Pick one shape for everything, or each part on its own in the table. The small screens show which part is which.
The categories run down a rail beside the results, always above the keyboard. Tap one to jump to its results; drag along the rail to run through them.

Favorites are the apps you want at hand right away. Pick them yourself, let Freiraum add the apps you open most, or both. They show as soon as the search opens while Favorites is switched on in the categories below; otherwise tap the star in the rail. A long press on an app in the search adds or removes it. The counting stays on your phone.
Picked, topped up with the most opened
At the top, or right on the keyboard within easy reach of the thumb.
Fill, text and border, for everything or part by part
Pick a color set for everything, or tap a part in the table to give it its own fill, text color and border. The small screens show the result.
One field for everything: apps, contacts, places, links, settings and more, and whatever is not on the phone goes on to your search engine, maps or AI app.
Page, search field, category rail, results, strip over the keyboard
Layout, categories and their order, search engines, AI apps, favorites
Page, letters, A-Z rail, search button, search field
Edge, what is shown, its own search
Tap the icon to change it
This is the folder as it opens. Tap a widget, app or element to change or move it; the empty tile adds something.
How many apps and elements sit side by side in each row. Widgets always take the whole width.
Folders gather apps, places, links and widgets behind one icon. Tap a folder to arrange it, or make a new one.
Pick apps below; you can add widgets and more right after.
The first engine runs with a tap on the card and with Enter. Drag to change the order.
The query is handed to the app like a share. The launcher itself never goes online.
Put %s where the query goes, for example https://example.org/search?q=%s. Without %s the query is added as ?q=.
To pick in the same card
A picture of your own or an icon pack symbol replaces the standard one. Pictures are cut to a square.
No AI app yet. Without one the AI card stays hidden.
In the results, not in the rail
On demand: results after a tap in the rail
The categories as a rail beside the results
Off: only the Search column counts
Icon pack: %1$s · shape and size for all apps
The name bubble and the magnifier while dragging along the rail
Its results show with every query.
A place in the rail. Rail only = on demand, results after a tap there.
Tap a symbol to change it and its color, drag ≡ to change the order.
The web result opens the first engine with a tap; the others sit right below it in the same card to pick instead. Tap a symbol to give it a picture of your own.
The AI result hands the query to the first app with a tap; the others sit right below it in the same card. Tap a symbol to give it a picture of your own.
This link could not be opened
Not an address a link can open
Upper and lower case do not matter. Without a code the app stays findable by its name.
This is neither a Freiraum design nor a Freiraum wallpaper

Extensions bring something new into the launcher: a ready-made look, pictures for every page, or data for a widget. Freiraum has no internet access. You pick them in the browser, and a tap there opens them here.
Clock, Notes and Music are included
Weather needs an app that brings the data
Opens the overview in the browser
You place widgets on a page as a row. Some show what is already on the phone. Others need data from the internet and get it from an app of their own, so the launcher itself stays offline.
With a data source of their own
The Weather widget shows what a weather app sends to the launcher, for example Breezy Weather with its data sharing for Gadgetbridge switched on.
Apps that bring the weather, and how to set them up
Opened from outside (a link or a file) and already added. Apply it only if you trust where it came from. It changes only the look and can be deleted again at any time.
Pick a section on the left.
Widgets sit on a page as a row. You can add them later under Settings → Pages, at the page in question.
Notes and lists right on the page
Controls what is playing. Needs access to notifications
Needs a weather app that brings the data, because Freiraum does not go online
Long press on apps, folder entries and notes
The Weather widget is already included. For now its data comes from Breezy Weather through its Gadgetbridge sharing. More weather sources are in the works.
